title: French party leader criticizes von der Leyen's decision to allocate €6.1 bln to Kiev
summary: Nicolas Dupont-Aignan says the EU is spending its funds on other people's conflicts while demanding "ever greater efforts" from its own people

title: China bets on early port and power deals in Sudan to secure post-war economic edge
summary: China is moving early to secure a role in Sudan’s reconstruction, pursuing port and power agreements with the army-backed government while the war continues and many Western countries maintain only a limited presence. One expert also said Beijing was using the prospect of future investment as a bilateral incentive to encourage warring parties to cease hostilities. Sudan signed an agreement with the China Harbour Engineering Company in July to upgrade existing ports and build new ones. Meanwhile,...
